plan.estimand: Minimum development sample size for continuous prediction model
plan.hypothesis: Model performance precision: intercept multiplicative margin of error ≤1.1, residual SD multiplicative margin of error ≤1.1, mean outcome multiplicative margin of error ≤1.1
assumptions: pmsampsize package version 1.1.3 used
Continuous outcome prediction model
Riley criteria applied
Default package precision criteria for continuous outcomes
Normal distribution of residuals assumed
Shrinkage factor 0.90 reflects anticipated optimism in model
Margin of error criteria apply to intercept, residual SD, and mean outcome
Maximum absolute difference R-squared (apparent vs adjusted) 0.05 on Nagelkerke scale (for reference with binary/survival contexts)
scientific_notes: pmsampsize is a specialized R package (Archer et al.) implementing Riley et al. (2022) criteria for prediction model sample size
For continuous outcomes, Riley criteria balance precision in model parameters and apparent-vs-adjusted R-squared shrinkage
Shrinkage 0.90 indicates expected retained R-squared is 90% of apparent R-squared; affects sample size requirement
Multiplicative margin of error (MMoE) thresholds constrain precision intervals: e.g., MMoE=1.1 means 90% CI width on ratio scale
Will execute pmsampsize::pmsampsize with type='Continuous' and report achieved design specifications
